slices.summary: Generalized concrete dependency resolution across persistent and ephemeral sample sources while preserving exact committed authority and issuing explicit transient driver tokens.

slices.title: Transient derivation fingerprints
slices.summary: Derived fingerprints now compose exact concrete and transient driver authority without payload serialization, object identity, whole-sample keys, or fake semantic IDs.

slices.title: Derived evaluation over a sample source
slices.summary: Derived evaluation now accepts ephemeral sample sources, traverses only the requested closure with shared diamond memoization, preserves persistent snapshot parity for unaffected branches, and exposes no partial view on stale or invalid evaluation.

slices.title: Bounded caller-owned evaluator cache
slices.summary: Applied-family evaluators now provide an explicit bounded interior-sample cache with normalized progress keys, deterministic LRU eviction, hit and miss statistics, reset, idempotent disposal, and application-local ownership; capacity defaults to zero and persistent endpoints plus the existing snapshot-derived cache remain unchanged.

slices.title: Seek rewind repeat and retry laws
slices.summary: Bounded permutation laws prove direct seek, forward and rewind, repeated equivalent progress, reset, disposal and recreation, and deterministic failure retries preserve exact sampled and derived values without poisoning the cache or changing persistent history.

slices.title: Authority and compiler checkpoint
slices.summary: Sampling, derived views, cache hits and eviction, reset, disposal, and recreation leave snapshots, versions, journal, change records, correspondence, provenance, lineage, and recovery exact. One direct-owner inference fixture explains the measured 106981 types and 181525 instantiations; the sole approved ratchet sets formula-derived ceilings of 109200 and 187000.

slices.title: Immutable reparameterization
slices.summary: State-family definitions now reparameterize an applied family from its exact original persistent source into a distinct immutable application with frozen typed parameters and immediate-source provenance; reused or foreign source authority is rejected and evaluator caches remain isolated.

slices.title: Canonical parameterized-tax economics seam
slices.summary: Added a domain-owned exact-rational explicit-tax evaluation seam that delegates market clearing and welfare to existing constructors, preserves exact endpoints for two markets, and reports malformed, negative, and out-of-axis inputs without importing semantic state.

slices.title: Supply-tax family and one-driver endpoint
slices.summary: Added a dedicated internal supply-tax state family with one exact market.taxAmount update; buyer-facing supply, equilibrium, incidence, and government revenue remain explicit derived nodes backed by canonical parameterized economics.

slices.title: Exact supply-tax intermediate samples
slices.summary: Proved exact five-point supply-tax sampling across two markets: only tax is interpolated, while equilibrium, incidence, and revenue are recomputed through canonical economics with endpoint and direct-seek parity and no numeric progress conversion.

slices.title: Supply-tax sample-status and cache pressure
slices.summary: Added generic exact-progress-derived sampleStatus metadata and proved on supply-tax that it is not semantic state; requested closures remain selective, unchanged model dependencies retain persistent tokens, and the caller-owned sample cache stays bounded and disposable.

slices.title: Supply-tax reparameterization branches
slices.summary: Proved tax-2 and tax-6 reparameterized branches share the exact baseline but own distinct endpoints, exact fingerprints, immediate-source provenance, recovery records, and isolated evaluator caches under interleaved sampling.

slices.title: Circle state-family fixture
slices.summary: Added a compact test-owned circle state family with one exact unit-ID radius driver and explicit derived area and point-dependent response slots; executable math authority remains in the existing renderer-free differentiable map and outside persistent snapshots.

slices.title: Nonlinear circle sampling and unit repairs
slices.summary: Certified nonlinear circle-family sampling across nonmonotonic exact progress, with derived area and point response recomputed from one unit-tagged radius and no durable history growth.

slices.title: Cross-caller API scale and compiler pressure
slices.summary: Certified one unchanged shared family/evaluator API across exact supply-tax and approximate-unit circle callers: two deterministic 257-position probes each stayed within a 16-entry cache, preserved one durable operation per application, evaluated only requested derived closures, and required no API or inference-ratchet change.
